integrity.mathematical_basis: All-size constructive proof and two separate small-size verification implementations

limitations: Only labelled equally sized clique pairs with disjoint unit-weight cross edges, uniform random sequential binary closed-neighborhood minority, and tie retention. No absorption-time, hitting-probability, or spectral-gap theorem. Historical novelty is a comparison-based assessment, not an absolute priority guarantee.
title: Parity-preserving attractor populations on partially matched clique pairs
